Rumor: |"You defended Fort Virak against General Serien. A friend of mine fought there!"
|"Good thing you stopped General Serien. Too bad about Tanval's son, though."
|"Heard you wiped out that Goblin tribe in Fungal Grotto. Maybe I can go visit the place now."
|"Don't know why the Ashlanders attacked a holy order, but at least someone stopped them."
|"Plague in Narsis? Hah! Those Dark Elves wouldn't know a real plague if it crawled out and bit them."
|"The Ordinators seem on edge. What are the Dark Elves so nervous about?"
|"If you hadn't defeated that nasty little Elf, Vox, I'm sure our great King Jorunn would have taken care of her."
|"I heard Ten-Maur-Wolk was full of Daedra. You're no milk-drinker, that's for sure."
|"When did the skin-stealers take Hrondar? Weeks ago? Months? Years?"
|"The Dominion never should've gone to Loriasel. The lamias ate them for breakfast!"
|"Aren't you the Champion of Windhelm? The one that stopped Fildgor Orcthane?"
|"I heard that Skorvild baited the giants into attacking Lower Yorgrim."
|"Did you hear? Someone stole Queen Nurnhilde's body from the Royal Tombs."
|"Caught the King's old mage red-handed in Lodorr's tomb, did you? You've got my thanks."
|"Heard you found some witch raising Draugr in the Hall of the Dead. We live in dangerous times."
|"Now that the giant threat is over, I'm going to start trading in Lower Yorgrim again."
|"I love mead. I love Voljar mead. Well, really, I love any mead. I'm not that particular."
|"Heard the Orcthane sent thugs to harass the owners of Voljar's Meadery. But you can't keep a good Nord down."
|"The Stormfist Brigade made a critical mistake at Cradlecrush. They should have left the mammoths alone."
|"The King and his councilors are camped at Jorunn's Stand, getting ready to move against Fildgor Orcthane. It's about time, I say."
|"We Nords will root out that bastard Fildgor. He won't be able to hide in the hills for very long."
|"Maybe Jorunn deserved this fate. Maybe Fildgor was right all along. The Nord people must stand together."
|"I'm starting to think the Skald-King is invincible. Not even poison can kill the smug bastard!"
|"Let me get this straight. The King was poisoned and an Argonian saved him by entering his dreams? That's a little far-fetched."
|"Can you believe the Reachmen raised Sinmur's ghost? It's a good thing you were there."
|"I'm trying to compose a song about your heroics at Fallowstone Hall."
|"They say Aera Earth-Turner was working with the Worm Cult."
|"Hail, Geirmund's Guardian!"
|"You're the favored one, the one Ysgramor appeared to."
|"Aren't you the one who defeated the ghost of Sinmur?"
|"The return of Arch-Mage Shalidor! Truly a reason for all sons of Skyrim to smile."
|"You're the one who caught the traitor Thorulf. Too bad about Thane Unnvald, but Hallfrida's a good leader."
